answer: Behavioral correlation clustering. Cluster agents by transaction-graph overlap and timing fingerprints; identities whose subgraphs converge above threshold are flagged as one operator. Enforcement: flagged clusters lose settlement rights until members independently bridge to distinct external counterparties over 30 days. Attacker cost: each fake identity must build a separate history across the canyon of unrelated accounts, forcing real per-identity capital and time rather than a forge of cheap clones.
